title: GPS-STRICT-RETRY-BANK: geometric retry weights and revised literal cutoffs

claims.statement: For every N>=2 and s modulo N, n=ceil(log2N), the ONE GPS-STRICT-RETRY-BANK physical algorithm in proof.md recovers the ENTIRE s with unconditional probability at least1-2^-8 under the exact canonical independent-ideal-copy model. It uses the unchanged GPS profile, tree/search/signed/decoder instruments but CHANGES literal Qcap and Wcap, recomputes ALL dependent extraction h_e/t_V/fallback Cf/counters/layouts, and gives a NEW pre-batch geometric-retry and uncapped/capped success proof. Quantitative return p>=67/128 yields kappa128/67 and weighted decay64/67; the root expected weight is below64*2^R instead of2m2^R. Qcap=1024(ceil(2*(128/67)^m*q0*H0)+2n), Wcap=1024*64*2^R*H0 on n>=256. For n<256 the original clean exhaustive branch is retained. The complete native ATTEMPT is used only for n>=2^4096; below that threshold the generic bit interpreter executes the NEW logical cap/extraction program. No old parent output-law equality, post-input fixed-residue success bound, expected-only runtime, source purification/control/inverse, extra QRAM, free word arithmetic, instruction oracle or arbitrary phase primitive is assumed. Every source fee/move, original, bit/gate generation, address, padding/inactive allocation, failed attempt, refused-guard children, initialization, private erasure and entire output-first cleanup is counted on EVERY branch. ALL FIVE guarantees hold jointly for THIS SAME modified actual configuration. Charged sequential time is O(n^2(log2n)^2 2^((176777/250000)sqrt(n log2n))), exact growth index1/2. The complete native cost O(R^2 L w_i) and NEW literal weighted cap give O(nR^2 L2^R); all generic work is bounded by n^20(Qcap+q0+1), absorbed by the proved for-every-fixed-A cap/product gap. Actual source/extraction/cutoff losses retain total below2^-8. The exact inner coefficient comes from the unchanged proved profile, not an unknown inner big-O.
